Snap''' is a [[spell]] that deals [[cold damage]] to enemies in an area, leaving [[chilled ground]] that expands and deals cold [[damage over time]]. It has a cooldown that can be bypassed with [[Frenzy Charge]]s. It also has a 25% chance to grant a frenzy charge when you kill an enemy within its area of effect. __TOC__ ==Skill functions and interactions== {{c|mod|Modifiers to Spell Damage apply to this Skill's Damage Over Time effect}}: this modifier allows spell damage modifiers to modify the skill's natural cold damage over time. It will not apply to other types of damage over time, such as [[Ignite]]. [[Chilled Ground]]: Cold Snap creates an expanding [[chilled ground]] that causes enemies to be chilled. While its base effect will scale with the player or skill's modifiers to cold and non-damaging ailments, it is not considered a chill inflicted by the player, limiting the use of certain stats. (See [[chilling area]].) [[Trigger]]: Even if the appropriate [[charges]] are available, Cold Snap's [[cooldown]] cannot be bypassed when triggered.https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/6qzl0g/its_been_almost_a_year_since_an_update_broke_cold/dl1jbtc/ ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Cold
